# DSH Mobile Companion

> Android app plus a local, dependency-free bridge to control DeepSeek Harness from your phone inside your private network (ZeroTier or Tailscale). No cloud, no account, no API key stored, nothing exposed to the Internet.

## What it is

- Android client (minSdk 26, target 35) that opens your DeepSeek Harness chat from the phone.
- Local Node bridge (no npm dependencies) that proxies to Harness on the computer, listening only on loopback and the private VPN interface.
- Quick commands and code keys configurable per profile (writing or code).
- Phone notes sent to the computer when it comes back.
- Signed APK verified by SHA-256; one-time device approval.

## What it is not

- Not an on-device AI model and not a cloud service.
- Not an official DeepSeek client; it requires DeepSeek Harness on your PC.
- Does not work with the computer turned off; does not store API keys.

## Key facts

- Platforms: Android 8.0+; computer side: Node.js 22.15+ and DeepSeek Harness.
- Network model: phone and PC on the same private VPN; bridge exposed only on loopback and the VPN interface.
- Distribution: APK via GitHub Releases; no Play Store, no npm dependencies.
- One active computer at a time; kill switch and access-key rotation available.
- Language: UI and docs in Spanish and English (README also in 7 languages).
